verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a SaaS communications platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Aircall offers a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of its core product. Importing recordings into your own infrastructure and using the public API, webhooks, or partner sandboxes are adjacent integration features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
